hooks.command:
# Inject a refusal reminder when the prompt mentions a technology that the
# Defra frontend standards forbid. Fires deterministically on every prompt
# submission — does not rely on Claude Code's skill-selector picking up
# frontend-tech-stack/SKILL.md.

INPUT=$(cat)
PROMPT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.prompt // empty')

if [[ -z "$PROMPT" ]]; then exit 0; fi

if printf '%s' "$PROMPT" | grep -qiE '\b(tailwind|react|vue|angular|svelte|jquery|bootstrap|typescript|express)\b'; then
  cat <<'BANNER'
[frontend-developer plugin reminder]
The user message mentions a technology that is **not allowed** by the Defra
frontend standards. Before doing anything else, refuse the request on the
first turn:

1. State plainly that the request is **not allowed** by the Defra frontend
   standards (or the GOV.UK Design System, whichever applies).
2. Name the rule ("no SPA frameworks", "no utility CSS frameworks like
   Tailwind", etc.) and the standard that owns it.
3. Offer the compliant alternative in one or two sentences (Hapi +
   Nunjucks + SCSS importing govuk-frontend + progressive-enhancement
   vanilla JS + Vitest).
4. Only after the refusal, if genuinely ambiguous, ask any clarifying
   question needed to deliver the alternative.

See skill frontend-tech-stack for the full approved/forbidden list.
BANNER
fi

exit 0

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.js|*.mjs) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run lint -- --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; npm run format:fix -- "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.scss && -f "$FILE" ]]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.njk && -f "$FILE" ]]; then if grep -qE '<script[^>]*>|<style[^>]*>|\bstyle=' "$FILE"; then echo "Security: inline <script>, <style>, or style= attribute found in $(basename $FILE). Move scripts to external .js files and styles to external .scss files." >&2; exit 2; fi; COUNT=$(grep -c '| safe' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [[ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]]; then echo "Warning: $COUNT use(s) of '| safe' in $(basename $FILE) — only use on pre-sanitised trusted content, never on user-supplied data." >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git (commit|push)'; then BRANCH=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$BRANCH" == 'main' || "$BRANCH" == 'master' ]]; then echo "Direct commits and pushes to '$BRANCH' are not allowed. Create a feature branch first (e.g. feature/my-change)." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0
